1.  WELCOME AND INTRODUCTIONS  

The Chair welcomed Members to the first meeting of the HSCCA Overview & Scrutiny 
Committee and outlined the Committee's role as a critical friend to the Combined 
County Authority Board. 

The Committee would review policy, examine performance, challenge constructively 
and make recommendations in the interests of residents across the region. Members
